note: Guinea-Bissau: nationals of the ECOWAS states, Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger enter without a visa; everyone else gets a visa on arrival at Bissau airport or the four designated land posts (or one from a mission beforehand); the e-Visa service is suspended. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Guinea-Bissau
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries can visit Guinea-Bissau without a visa: All ECOWAS member states Burkina Faso Mali Niger ... Citizens of countries that are not visa-exempt must obtain a visa to enter Guinea-Bissau. Visas may be obtained on arrival at Osvaldo Vieira International Airport in Bissau, or at one of four designated land border posts ... The electronic visa service is currently suspended.
